Test Title: Verify item creation fails when item name is empty or whitespaces
Pre-conditions: Manager is on Menu Management screen.
Test Steps: Click "Add Menu Item" -> Enter "" or "   " into Name field -> Fill valid category & price -> Submit form
Expected Result: System blocks submission and displays: "Item name is required and cannot be empty".
Actual Result: Field validation error displayed inline; submission blocked.

Test Title: Verify case-insensitive uniqueness validation against existing menu items
Test Steps: Click "Add Menu Item" -> Enter "espresso" (lowercase) -> Submit form
Expected Result: System displays error: "An item named 'espresso' already exists in the menu. Names must be unique."
Actual Result: Case-insensitive duplicate check rejected duplicate successfully.
